Upcoming Milestones

ROADMAP 2026

Synergix's technical roadmap for 2026 — from global infrastructure to the sovereign AI.

Jun 2026 🌐
Global Connectivity & Infrastructure Scaling
Integration of internet search capabilities for Synergix's AI. Expansion and optimization of our server capacity to boost performance, reduce latency, and strengthen the core of our artificial intelligence.
Jul 2026 🏆
Governance & Rewards System
Launch of a royalty system based on contribution quality. Implementation of a 'Judges System' to evaluate and reward outstanding users with Synergix's native token.
Aug 2026 💻
Web Platform Launch
Official presentation of the Synergix web ecosystem. Users will have centralized access to our complete suite of advanced tools and AI capabilities from the website interface.
Sep 2026 ⛏️
Node Deployment & Mining
Introduction of the mining protocol for infrastructure operators. Users hosting Synergix Ghost Nodes strengthen the decentralized network and receive direct incentives in the native currency.
Oct 2026 🗄️
Native Decentralized Storage
Presentation and deployment of Synergix's own decentralized storage solution, designed to guarantee data sovereignty, security, and network immutability.
Nov 2026 🧠
Cognitive Evolution & Advanced Computing
Expansion of AI infrastructure through NVIDIA-powered servers. Integration of cutting-edge language models specialized in deep reasoning and advanced programming.
Dec 2026 📱
Open Source Mobile Ecosystem
Official launch of Synergix apps for iOS and Android. Built under an open-source philosophy to guarantee transparency, security, and global community accessibility.
Vision 2027 🔮
Vision 2027
The roadmap and strategic objectives for 2027 will be officially revealed to our community on December 15, 2026.
